newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile August industrial output rises, sales fall.
newsitem.headline: Chile August industrial output rises, sales fall.

text.p: Chilean industrial production rose a scant 0.5 percent in August compared with the same month last year, while sales fell 0.7 percent over the same period, said the industrial trade group Sofofa.
Figures from Sofofa showed output in August was 0.4 percent lower than in July with sales dropping 2.5 percent.
August's data brings the rise in industrial production in the first eight months of the year to 2.2 percent with sales up 2.6 percent.
The figures, which add to recent government data showing a slowdown, are further signs of the cooling of Chile's robust economic growth as the result of a year-long Central Bank credit squeeze.
